files.README.md:
# Havensgill Marine - survey office

Passage logs record speed over ground in knots.
The coastal survey report the office files is written in kilometres an hour.

turns.prompt: Havensgill Marine is writing up the passage of the survey launch through the North Sound. The log holds a speed over ground of 17.5 knots, and a knot is 1.852 kilometres an hour. What speed in kilometres an hour goes into the survey report? Give the answer as a single number, with no unit in the reply. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
